description: Source file implementing TransactionCallbackInvoker class for handling transaction callbacks in Android SurfaceFlinger, including adding transactions, managing callback handles, and sending callbacks to listeners.

classes.name: CallbackHandle
classes.description: Represents a callback handle associated with a transaction listener, callback IDs, and surface control.

methods.name: addEmptyTransaction
methods.description: Adds an empty transaction record for a listener.

methods.name: addOnCommitCallbackHandles
methods.description: Adds callback handles that contain on-commit callbacks, filtering out others.

methods.name: addCallbackHandles
methods.description: Adds multiple callback handles with associated jank data.

methods.name: findOrCreateTransactionStats
methods.description: Finds existing transaction stats for a listener and callback IDs or creates a new one.

methods.name: addCallbackHandle
methods.description: Associates a callback handle with transaction stats, updating fences and surface stats.

methods.name: addPresentFence
methods.description: Sets the present fence for the transaction.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Dispatches transaction completed callbacks to listeners, optionally only on commit.
